J. McDaniels''' (born February 9, 1993) is an American basketball player who recently completed his college career at [[Clemson University]]. ==College career== McDaniels, a 6'6" [[small forward]] from [[Birmingham, Alabama]], came to [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]] as an unheralded recruit from Central Park Christian School. He played limited minutes as a freshman in [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12]], averaging 3.9 [[Points per game|points]] and 1.8 [[rebounds per game]]. As a sophomore, McDaniels became a starter for the Tigers. He averaged 10.9 points and 5.0 rebounds, and finished second in the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) in [[blocked shot]]s with 2.1 per game.{{cite web | last = | first = | title = K. J. McDaniels CBSSports.com profile | work = CBSSports.com | date = | url = http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/players/playerpage/1904213/kj-mcdaniels | accessdate = May 4, 2014}} As a junior in [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14]], McDaniels became one of the top players in the ACC. He averaged 17.1 points and 7.1 rebounds per game. He led the ACC in blocks per game at 2.8 and at the conclusion of the regular season was named first team All-ACC and the conference Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite web | last = | first = | title = Clemson's McDaniels named ACC defensive player of the year | work = GoUpstate.com | date = March 11, 2014 | url = http://www.goupstate.com/article/20140311/ARTICLES/140319921 | accessdate = May 4, 2014}} In the postseason, he led the Tigers to the [[2014 National Invitation Tournament]]. McDaniels led the team to the tournament semifinals in [[Madison Square Garden (1925)|Madison Square Garden]].{{cite web | last = | first = | title = Clemson rallies past Belmont, advances to NIT semifinals | work = [[CBSSports.com]] | date = March 25, 2014 | url = http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/gametracker/recap/NCAAB_20140325_BELMONT@CLEM | accessdate = May 4, 2014}} ==Professional career== Folling his junior season, McDaniels decided to forego his senior season at Clemson and declare for the [[2014 NBA draft]].{{cite web | last = Feldman | first = Dan | title = Report: Clemson’s K.J.
